method: Unmodified ordinary viewer Terrarium samples, bilinearly interpolated at source pixel centers.2.5m review spacing oversamples coarse global DEM and is not survey resolution. No flattening or fitted terrain.
attribution: Mapzen/Terrain Tiles; NASA/USGS and other open elevation sources
limitations: Coarse global terrain may contain urban/vegetation/bridge returns and cannot resolve original stone footings, riverbed, quay walls or all three arch-channel beds.
